title: Action register bundle omits department directory for its documented department filter
actual: Current get_screen_bundle(action_register), including omitted sections, lists only GET /quality/actions, GET /quality/actions/{action_id}, POST /quality/actions/{action_id}/complete and GET /quality/actions/register/pdf. Rule224b213871 requires a department filter and GET /quality/actions takes department_id, but the bundle does not list its department directory. This is a metadata omission, not an allegation that the directory API is absent or forbidden.
expected: Add GET /admin/departments to the screen bundle/task contracts for the named active-department filter, or explicitly document another authoritative directory. GET /admin/departments description names itself as every department-id field's active-by-name directory (decision62), and the user's global instructions explicitly name it. No typed or guessed department ID is required.
steps: Read action_register bundle and all omitted sections on current build; inspect rule224b213871 and GETquality/actions department_id query; compare listed endpoints with GETadmin/departments. As demo.quality, GETadmin/departments returns200 active named departments.
evidence: 180-bundle.json,180-extra.json,180-endpoint-0.json and180-endpoint-4.json saved in docs/phase-p9a-2026-11-06/.
